_about: Ballroom Quest syllabus v2 (Newcomer + Bronze, four styles). Steps are written for the LEADER: [foot, direction, beats, turn_degrees(+ = right), count_label, weight(optional, default true)]. Directions: fwd, back, side_l, side_r, diag_fwd_l/r, diag_back_l/r, cross_fwd, cross_back, cross_behind, close, replace, in_place, slip_back (the moving foot slides back about half a stride from where it is) and slip_fwd. The follower's part is the mirror image (other foot; fwd<->back, side_l<->side_r, diag_fwd_r<->diag_back_l, diag_fwd_l<->diag_back_r, slip_back<->slip_fwd; cross, close, replace and in_place unchanged) except where a figure has follow_steps: {leader step index: [foot, direction] or [foot, direction, weight]} gives the follower's own step on that count (beats and counts always come from the leader's step; the optional third value says whether she takes weight when that differs from him). Positions: closed, promenade, open, fan. A figure can follow another only if the free foot and the position match; Quickstep figures also carry end_travel (fwd/back), and the next figure must start moving the same way; only_after / only_before list the only figures that may come straight before / after it. Each dance has rise: 'waltz' (3-beat rise and fall), 'swing' (rise over each slow or quick-quick) or 'none'. source: 'moore' = International Standard facts from Alex Moore, Ballroom Dancing (cues are our own words); 'v1' = original syllabus; 'general' = common Bronze syllabus knowledge, to be checked by a coach. Where the book overlaps a figure's last step with the next figure's first step, each step is listed only once here.

std_waltz.name: Slow Waltz
std_waltz.feel: Swing and sway, 1-2-3 with rise at the end of 1 and lowering at the end of 3. Closed hold throughout.

std_foxtrot.name: Slow Foxtrot
std_foxtrot.feel: Long, gliding, lazy steps: slow-quick-quick. The smoothest and most continuous of the dances.

std_tango.name: Tango
std_tango.feel: Staccato and level with no rise and fall. Feet placed, not swung; walks curve slightly left. (Slow = 2 game beats, quick = 1.)

quickstep.name: Quickstep
quickstep.feel: Fast and light with chasses and locks: slow = 2 beats, quick = 1. Stay up on the toes through the quicks.

std_viennese.name: Viennese Waltz
std_viennese.feel: Fast rotating turns, 60 bars a minute. Changes switch between Natural and Reverse Turns.

waltz.name: Waltz
waltz.feel: Rise and fall, 1-2-3 with the strongest step on 1. Swing and sway.

tango.name: Tango
tango.feel: Staccato, no rise and fall. Walks curve slightly left. Slow = 2 beats, quick = 1 beat.

foxtrot.name: Foxtrot
foxtrot.feel: Smooth, gliding Slow-Slow-Quick-Quick. Long walking slows, soft quicks.

viennese.name: Viennese Waltz
viennese.feel: Fast, sweeping 1-2-3 turns. American style may open out of hold for underarm turns.

chacha.name: Cha Cha
chacha.feel: Counted 2, 3, 4-and-1. Break steps on 2-3, a quick chasse on 4-and-1. Straight legs, Cuban motion.

rumba.name: Rumba
rumba.feel: Slow and sensual. Counted 2, 3, 4-1: the side step on 4 is held through 1.

jive.name: Jive
jive.feel: Bouncy and fast. Rock step on 1-2, chasse 3-a-4, chasse 5-a-6.

samba.name: Samba
samba.feel: Carnival bounce through the knees, counted 1-a-2. The 'a' is a very quick step.

paso.name: Paso Doble
paso.feel: A proud Spanish march, one step per beat. Tall posture, sharp appels (stamps).

am_chacha.name: Cha Cha
am_chacha.feel: Counted 2, 3, 4-and-1, like the Latin cha cha, with more open and side-by-side figures.

am_rumba.name: Rumba
am_rumba.feel: Slow, quick, quick box rhythm with Cuban motion: the hips settle as each step takes weight.

swing.name: East Coast Swing
swing.feel: Six-count swing: triple step, triple step, rock step. Relaxed, bouncy and playful.

bolero.name: Bolero
bolero.feel: Slow, romantic rumba-like dance with rise and fall: a long rising slow, then two quicks.

mambo.name: Mambo
mambo.feel: Fast and punchy: break on 2, hold on 1. Strong Cuban hip action.

figures.name: LF Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Left forward, side, close. It takes you from a Reverse Turn into a Natural Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Right back, side, close. Let him carry you straight down the room.
figures.mistake: Letting the side step drift forward; keep it to the side so the next turn starts square.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: Use it to switch your free foot from left to right without turning.

figures.name: RF Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Right forward, side, close. The bridge from a Natural Turn into a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Left back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and trying to start a Reverse Turn straight after a Natural Turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower at end of 3

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right foot forward and turn right: forward-side-close, then back-side-close. Three-eighths per half.
figures.follow_cue: Left back and turn right, then forward-side-close on the outside of the turn.
figures.mistake: Making the second step short when going forward; the outside partner needs the long step.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4 (no foot rise), up 5-6, lower end of 6

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left foot forward and turn left: forward-side-close, back-side-close. Three-eighths per half.
figures.follow_cue: Right back and turn left; on 4-6 go forward-side-close around him.
figures.mistake: Starting it right after a Natural Turn; dance a RF Closed Change in between.
figures.rise_fall: Same pattern as the Natural Turn

figures.name: Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, cross the left foot behind and open her into promenade. You do not turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back, diagonally back, then cross your right foot behind as you turn your head to the right.
figures.mistake: Trying to close back into closed hold; the Whisk ends in promenade, so a Chasse from Promenade comes next.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Chasse from Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Right foot through in promenade, then side-close-side as she comes back to face you.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot through, then turn to face him on side-close-side.
figures.mistake: Rushing the 'and': steps 2 and the close share one beat.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up 2-&-3, lower end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: In the book the next step (right foot outside her) is the first step of a Natural Turn.

figures.name: Hesitation Change
figures.lead_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then step back, pull the right foot beside the left and hold. The left foot closes without weight.
figures.follow_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then forward and side, and hold as your foot brushes in.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the last step; the left foot must stay free for the Reverse Turn.
figures.rise_fall: Normal rise on 1-3, no rise on 4-6

figures.name: Reverse Corte
figures.lead_cue: First half of a Reverse Turn, then step back on the right turning left and draw the left foot in without weight. Hold it on 5 and 6 (two taps, no weight change) while she turns, then finish back-side-close.
figures.follow_cue: First half of a Reverse Turn, then forward on the left, a small side step on the right and close the left while he holds; finish forward-side-close.
figures.mistake: Shifting weight onto the left foot during the hold; it stays free so you can step back on it.
figures.rise_fall: Rise on 2 of the corte, lower end of 3; normal rise on the final back-side-close
figures.sway: Right on 2-3 of the corte, left on the last two steps
figures.cbm: On 1 and the first corte step
figures.notes_for_beginners: Steps 1-3 are the first half of the Reverse Turn the book says to dance first.

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn (+ Reverse 4-6)
figures.lead_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then pivot half a turn on the left foot, step forward and around; finish with the back half of a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: First half of a Natural Turn, then forward on the right and spin with him, back on the left and a small step diagonally forward on the right; finish forward-side-close turning left.
figures.mistake: Opening the knees on the pivot; keep the right foot in front and the thighs together.
figures.rise_fall: Normal rise on 1-3, rise end of 5 up on 6; normal rise on the reverse half
figures.sway: Right on 2-3, none on the spin
figures.notes_for_beginners: The book's usual follow-up (4-6 of a Reverse Turn) is built in so it ends facing diagonal wall.

figures.name: Preparation Step
figures.lead_cue: One slow step forward on the left to set up the Feather with the right foot free.
figures.follow_cue: One slow step back on the right.
figures.mistake: Starting the Feather from standing still; the prep step gives you the swing.

figures.name: Feather Step
figures.lead_cue: Slow, quick, quick: right forward, left forward, then right forward stepping outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, back; let him pass on your right side on the last quick.
figures.mistake: Turning the hips to get outside; lead with the left side of the body instead.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of 1, up on 2-3, lower end of 3
figures.notes_for_beginners: In the book the next left-foot step is also the first step of the following figure.

figures.name: Three Step
figures.lead_cue: Three straight walks forward, slow quick quick, with a rise on the quicks.
figures.follow_cue: Three walks back; reach long from the hip.
figures.mistake: Letting the quicks become short and choppy; they stay long and smooth.
figures.rise_fall: Rise at end of the first quick, up on the second quick, lower at end of the second quick

figures.name: Reverse Turn (with Feather Finish)
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, side, back; then back, side, and forward outside her (the Feather Finish).
figures.follow_cue: Back with a heel turn (close the left beside the right and turn on the heel), forward; then forward, side, back.
figures.mistake: Swinging the leader's second step too far forward; it goes to the side across the line of dance.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise end of 4, up 5-6

figures.name: Natural Turn (Heel Pull)
figures.lead_cue: Right forward and turn right, side, back; then back, pull the right foot beside the left on the heel, and forward on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Back and heel turn, forward; then forward, side, and brush back.
figures.mistake: Stepping the heel-pull foot behind; it lands beside the left foot, parallel and slightly apart.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; no rise on the heel pull

figures.name: Feather Finish
figures.lead_cue: Straight after a Closed Impetus: back on the right turning left, side, then forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, side, back; he passes on your right side.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to turn: about a quarter turn to the left brings you to the diagonal.

figures.name: Closed Impetus
figures.lead_cue: Natural Turn start, then back on the left and close the right with a heel turn, step side; follow with a Feather Finish.
figures.follow_cue: Natural Turn start with a heel turn, then forward around him, side, and a small step forward on the right, ready to go forward into the Feather Finish.
figures.mistake: Not closing the feet on the heel turn; the leader turns on the left heel with feet together.
figures.rise_fall: Normal rise on 1-3, rise end of 5 (heel turn), lower end of 6

figures.name: Change of Direction
figures.lead_cue: Three slows: left forward turning left, right slightly forward with the right side leading, then left forward across the body.
figures.follow_cue: Three slows back, turning with him; keep the feet low.
figures.mistake: Rising; this figure stays level with no rise at all.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Natural Weave
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn start, then keep travelling back on the left as she steps outside, back, side, and forward outside her.
figures.follow_cue: Natural turn start with a heel turn, forward outside him, then forward, side, and back as he steps outside you.
figures.mistake: Stopping on the fourth step; the six quicks flow without a check.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, stay up through the quicks, lower end of the last quick

figures.name: Walks (LF, RF)
figures.lead_cue: Two slow walks, heel first, curving very slightly left.
figures.follow_cue: Two slow walks back on the ball of the foot, then the heel.
figures.mistake: Rising onto the toes; tango walks stay level and grounded.
figures.rise_fall: None

figures.name: Progressive Side Step
figures.lead_cue: Quick, quick, slow: left forward across the body, right to the side, left forward again.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, back; stay compact in the hold.
figures.mistake: Taking the side step too wide; it is short and slightly back.

figures.name: Progressive Link
figures.lead_cue: Quick, quick: left forward, then right to the side and slightly back as you turn her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Right back, then a short step side and back as your head snaps right.
figures.mistake: Opening into promenade with the arms; it is the body that turns her.

figures.name: Closed Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow side in promenade, quick through, quick side, slow close back into closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, turn to face him, close.
figures.mistake: Starting it from closed position; it needs promenade first (Progressive Link).

figures.name: Back Corte
figures.lead_cue: Slow back on the left, quick back turning left, quick side, slow close.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Looking down while going back; keep the frame and head steady.

figures.name: Rock Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right forward turning right, rock back and forward, long step back, then back-side-close turning left.
figures.follow_cue: Back turning right, rock forward and back, forward, then forward-side-close.
figures.mistake: Rocking with the shoulders; the rock comes from the legs and the body stays still.

figures.name: Basic Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Quick quick slow turning left, crossing the left foot in front; then back, side, close. Three-quarters of a turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then forward, side, and close the left foot.
figures.mistake: Trying it after the left-foot walk; it follows a right-foot walk so the left is free.

figures.name: Quarter Turn to Right
figures.lead_cue: Slow, quick, quick, slow: right forward turning right, side, close, side.
figures.follow_cue: Back turning right, side, close, side.
figures.mistake: Making it flat; rise through the quicks and lower on the last slow.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, continue rising on 2-3, up on 4, lower end of 4

figures.name: Quarter Turn to Left (Heel Pivot)
figures.lead_cue: Back on the right turning left, bring the left heel back to it and pivot, change weight, then forward on the left.
figures.follow_cue: Forward turning left, side, close, back.
figures.mistake: Taking a big back step; the heel pivot needs a medium step so you can turn on the spot.
figures.rise_fall: Slight rise between 2 and 3

figures.name: Progressive Chasse
figures.lead_cue: After a Quarter Turn to Right: back turning left, then a wide chasse side-close-side.
figures.follow_cue: Forward turning left, then side-close-side.
figures.mistake: Closing the feet loosely; the chasse feet touch on the close.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 4
figures.notes_for_beginners: In the book the next step (right foot outside her) starts the following figure.

figures.name: Forward Lock
figures.lead_cue: Right forward outside her, left forward, cross the right behind, left forward. Up on the toes for the lock.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, cross the left in front, back.
figures.mistake: Crossing too loosely; the right foot locks tightly behind the left.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 4

figures.name: Natural Turn with Hesitation
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn forward-side-close, then back, heel pull the right foot beside the left and hold with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close turning right, then forward, side, and hold.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the last step; the left foot stays free for the Chasse Reverse Turn.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3, no rise on the heel pull

figures.name: Chasse Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left forward turning left, then side-close as you keep turning. Three-eighths of a turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back turning left, side, close.
figures.mistake: Under-turning; finish with your back to the line of dance.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3

figures.name: Natural Spin Turn
figures.lead_cue: Natural turn forward-side-close, then pivot half a turn on the left foot, right forward and around, left to the side.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, then forward and spin with him, back on the left, and a small step diagonally forward on the right.
figures.mistake: Letting the feet split on the pivot; keep the right foot in front and the knees together.
figures.rise_fall: Rise end of 1, up 2-3, lower end of 3; rise again end of 5, up 6, lower end of 6
figures.sway: Right on 2-3, none on the spin

figures.name: LF Forward Change (Reverse to Natural)
figures.lead_cue: Left forward, right diagonally forward, close. Turns you from Reverse Turns into Natural Turns.
figures.follow_cue: Right back, left diagonally back, close.
figures.mistake: Stopping the travel; keep moving down the room through the change.

figures.name: RF Forward Change (Natural to Reverse)
figures.lead_cue: Right forward, left diagonally forward, close. Turns you from Natural Turns into Reverse Turns.
figures.follow_cue: Left back, right diagonally back, close.
figures.mistake: Going into a Reverse Turn without it.

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Fast rotating turn to the right: forward-side-close, back-side-close, a full turn every six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close, staying close in the hold.
figures.mistake: Leaning back from your partner; stay connected through the body to rotate.

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Fast turn to the left: forward, side, cross the left foot in front; then back, side, close. A full turn every six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then forward, side, and cross the left foot in front.
figures.mistake: Not crossing on 3; the cross keeps the turn compact.

figures.name: Box Step
figures.lead_cue: Forward-side-close, back-side-close. Draw a square on the floor.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close. Wait for the lead before the side step.
figures.mistake: Stepping side on 1 instead of forward; forgetting to close the feet on 3.

figures.name: Left Foot Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the left, side, close. Use it to switch to a right-foot figure.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the right, side, close.
figures.mistake: Dancing it with a turn. It travels straight down the line of dance.

figures.name: Right Foot Closed Change
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the right, side, close. The bridge from a Natural Turn into a Reverse Turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and trying to start a Reverse Turn on the wrong foot.

figures.name: Left Box Turn
figures.lead_cue: A box step that turns a quarter to the left on each half.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close, turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Turning on the close; the turn happens on the first two steps of each half.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Forward box half while you raise your left hand, then back box half as she turns right under your arm.
figures.follow_cue: Back box half, then turn right under his arm with three small steps and come back into hold.
figures.mistake: Pulling her around with the arm; raise the hand and let her walk the turn.

figures.name: Natural Turn
figures.lead_cue: Right foot forward and start turning right. About 3/4 of a turn over six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot back, side, close as you turn right with him, then forward-side-close on the outside of the turn.
figures.mistake: Starting it with the left foot. A natural (right) turn always starts on the right foot for the leader.

figures.name: Reverse Turn
figures.lead_cue: Left foot forward and turn left. About 3/4 of a turn over six steps.
figures.follow_cue: Right foot back, side, close as you turn left with him, then forward-side-close around him.
figures.mistake: Following a Natural Turn directly. You need a Right Foot Closed Change in between.

figures.name: Whisk
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, cross the left foot behind and open the follower into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Back, diagonally back, then cross the right foot behind as you turn your head right.
figures.mistake: Closing back to closed position after a Whisk. You end in promenade, so a Chasse from Promenade comes next.

figures.name: Chasse from Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Right foot through in promenade, then side-close-side to bring her back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Left foot through, then turn to face him on side-close-side.
figures.mistake: Dancing it from closed position. It only starts from promenade (for example after a Whisk).

figures.name: Tango Walks
figures.lead_cue: Two slow walks, curving slightly left, feet placed with purpose.
figures.follow_cue: Two slow walks back, staying connected in the frame.
figures.mistake: Rising on the toes. Tango stays level.

figures.name: Basic (Walks + Tango Close)
figures.lead_cue: Slow, slow, quick, quick, slow. Draw the left foot in on the last slow without weight.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, back, side, draw the right foot in without weight.
figures.mistake: Putting weight on the drawn foot. The same foot stays free for the next figure.

figures.name: Progressive Link
figures.lead_cue: Quick-quick: left forward across your body, then a short right step out to the side, a little back, as you turn her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Right back across your body, then a short left step out to the side, a little back, as your head snaps right.
figures.mistake: Dancing a Closed Promenade without the Link first.

figures.name: Closed Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow side in promenade, quick through, quick side, slow close back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Side, through, turn to face him, close.
figures.mistake: Starting it from closed position. It needs promenade (use a Progressive Link).

figures.name: Corte
figures.lead_cue: Slow back into a soft dip on the left, slow recover forward, then tango close.
figures.follow_cue: Slow forward into the dip, recover back, then tango close.
figures.mistake: Bending forward at the waist in the dip; bend the standing knee and keep the frame upright.

figures.name: Left Rock Turn
figures.lead_cue: Forward turning left, rock back and forward, back, then side-close. About half a turn left.
figures.follow_cue: Back, rock forward and back, forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Making the rock big; it is a small weight change, almost in place.

figures.name: Forward Basic
figures.lead_cue: Slow, slow, quick, quick: walk, walk, side, close.
figures.follow_cue: Back, back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Rushing the slows. Each slow is two full beats.

figures.name: Back Basic
figures.lead_cue: Back, back, side, close. Keep the frame toward your partner.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Looking down at the feet while going backward.

figures.name: Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk through, then side-close to come back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Open to promenade, walk through with your left, side-close.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to close at the end. The quicks bring you back to closed position.

figures.name: Left Rock Turn
figures.lead_cue: Forward turning left, rock back, then side-close to finish the turn.
figures.follow_cue: Back, rock forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Rushing the rock; it is a slow.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Open to promenade, walk through while raising your left hand, side-close as she finishes the turn.
figures.follow_cue: Walk through, then turn right under his arm and side-close back into hold.
figures.mistake: Holding the hand tightly; keep a loose finger connection so she can turn.

figures.name: Twinkle to Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, then side-close as you open her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Slow back, then side-close as you turn to promenade.
figures.mistake: Staying closed; the quicks open the couple into promenade.

figures.name: Closing Twinkle
figures.lead_cue: From promenade: slow through on the right, then side-close as you square up to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Slow through on the left, then turn to face him on side-close.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to bring her square; she should face you by the close.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Smooth Foxtrot notes.

figures.name: Forward Change (left foot)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, close on the left foot to switch to right-foot turns.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Stopping your travel; keep moving around the room.

figures.name: Forward Change (right foot)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, side, close on the right foot to switch to left turns.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close.
figures.mistake: Skipping it between a right turn and a left turn.

figures.name: Hesitation (Balance Step)
figures.lead_cue: Step forward on the left and hold for two beats, the right foot closing without weight.
figures.follow_cue: Step back on the right and hold.
figures.mistake: Changing weight on the hold; the right foot stays free.

figures.name: Left (Reverse) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Turn left: forward, side, cross the left foot in front; back, side, close. About 3/8 of a turn per half.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then forward, side, and cross the left foot in front, turning left with him.
figures.mistake: Making big steps; Viennese is fast, so keep them compact.

figures.name: Right (Natural) Turn
figures.lead_cue: Turn right: forward-side-close, back-side-close.
figures.follow_cue: Back-side-close, forward-side-close, turning right.
figures.mistake: Starting it on the left foot.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Forward change while raising your left hand, then back change as she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Back change, then turn right under his arm and return to hold.
figures.mistake: Letting go completely; keep the hand connection through the turn.

figures.name: Basic (forward half)
figures.lead_cue: Rock forward, replace, chasse to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse to the right.
figures.mistake: Starting the rock on 1. In cha cha the break step is on 2.

figures.name: Basic (back half)
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse to the right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock forward, replace, chasse to the left.
figures.mistake: Taking the chasse too big. Keep the side steps small.

figures.name: Basic (full)
figures.lead_cue: Forward half then back half. Ends with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back half then forward half.
figures.mistake: Going straight from a full Basic into a New Yorker. The New Yorker needs the right foot free.

figures.name: New Yorker
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter and check forward through side-by-side, replace, chasse back to face. Then the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: check forward with the left, replace, chasse.
figures.mistake: Checking with the wrong foot. The leader's first check is with the right foot.

figures.name: Hand to Hand
figures.lead_cue: Like a New Yorker, but you check BACK side by side, holding one hand.
figures.follow_cue: Turn to face the same way as him and check back on the left, replace, chasse back to face; then the same on the right.
figures.mistake: Breaking forward instead of back.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Dance a back half while raising your left hand so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, turn right under his arm on 3, chasse to face him.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn on the wrong foot: the leader needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Fan
figures.lead_cue: Dance a back half while you lead her back and out to your left side into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, then back on the right as you start turning left, and chasse back away from him to end at a right angle on his left.
figures.mistake: Pushing her away; lead the fan with your body turn, not by throwing the arm.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Team video: 'Cha cha curl into fan'.

figures.name: Hockey Stick
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, chasse in place raising your left hand; then back, replace, and forward lock as she turns under.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, then a forward lock-step; forward, forward turning left under his arm, and chasse back into open position.
figures.mistake: Trying it from closed hold; it only starts from fan.

figures.name: Alemana
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, chasse in place as you raise your left hand; then back, replace, and a small chasse to the right as she turns right under your arm back into closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, then a forward lock-step; forward, forward turning right under his arm, and chasse to face him in closed hold.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn before she has walked up to your right side; let her travel first, then turn her on the second half.

figures.name: Basic (forward half)
figures.lead_cue: Forward, replace, side and hold through 1.
figures.follow_cue: Back, replace, side and hold.
figures.mistake: Not holding the side step. 4-1 is two beats.

figures.name: Basic (back half)
figures.lead_cue: Back, replace, side and hold.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, replace, side and hold.
figures.mistake: Bouncing. Rumba stays grounded with hip action.

figures.name: Basic (full box)
figures.lead_cue: Forward half then back half. Ends with the left foot free.
figures.follow_cue: Back half then forward half.
figures.mistake: Following a full basic with a Fan. The Fan needs the right foot free.

figures.name: New Yorker
figures.lead_cue: Quarter turn, check forward, replace, side. Then the other way.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him with your left foot first.
figures.mistake: Starting with the left foot. The leader needs the right foot free.

figures.name: Hand to Hand
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter and step back side by side holding one hand, replace, side. Then the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Turn to face the same way as him and step back on the left, replace, side; then back on the right on the other side.
figures.mistake: Breaking forward instead of back.

figures.name: Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Step across on the right and turn a full turn to the left on the spot, then side.
figures.follow_cue: Cross the left foot in front and turn right on the spot, step forward on the right as you finish the turn, then side.
figures.mistake: Travelling during the turn; stay on the spot.

figures.name: Fan
figures.lead_cue: Back half of the basic while you lead her out to your left into fan position.
figures.follow_cue: Forward, back, back as you turn away to his left side.
figures.mistake: Starting the Fan with the left foot or throwing her out with the arm; it needs the right foot free and a body lead.

figures.name: Hockey Stick
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, close and raise your left hand; she turns under it.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, forward; forward again, then forward turning left under his arm, and back.
figures.mistake: Dancing it from closed. A Hockey Stick only starts from fan position.

figures.name: Alemana
figures.lead_cue: From fan: forward, replace, close, then lead her to turn right under your arm back to closed.
figures.follow_cue: Close, forward, forward; then forward and forward again turning right under his arm, and close facing him.
figures.mistake: Trying it from open position after a Hockey Stick.

figures.name: Fallaway Rock
figures.lead_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse left, chasse right. Stay bouncy.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, replace, chasse right, chasse left.
figures.mistake: Flat feet. Jive chasses are danced on the balls of the feet.

figures.name: Change of Place Right to Left
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then raise your left hand on 4 so she turns under it to your left side. You end apart.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then turn right under his arm on the first chasse.
figures.mistake: Starting it from open position. It starts from closed; from open use Left to Right.

figures.name: Change of Place Left to Right
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then lead her to turn left under your arm while you turn right.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then turn left under his arm.
figures.mistake: Dancing it from closed position. You need to be apart first (Right to Left).

figures.name: Link
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then draw her in with a forward chasse back to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, then chasse forward into his arms.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to link. After open figures, the Link brings you back to closed.

figures.name: Fallaway Throwaway
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then chasse turning left as you send her out to open position, chasse in place.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, chasse to your right as you turn left, then chasse back away from him into open position.
figures.mistake: Throwing her with the arm; turn your body to lead it.

figures.name: American Spin
figures.lead_cue: Rock, chasse forward and push her right hand to spin her, then chasse in place.
figures.follow_cue: Rock, chasse forward into his hand, spin right on the second chasse.
figures.mistake: Holding on during her spin; let go and catch her hand again.

figures.name: Change of Hands Behind Back
figures.lead_cue: Rock, then pass her right hand behind your back as you turn.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back, chasse forward past him as he changes hands, then chasse back as you turn to face him.
figures.mistake: Trying it from closed hold. You need open position.

figures.name: Natural Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: Forward on the right, close, change weight; back on the left, close, change weight. Bounce through the knees.
figures.follow_cue: Back on the left, close, change; forward on the right, close, change.
figures.mistake: Dancing it flat; the samba bounce comes from softening the knees.

figures.name: Whisks to Right and Left
figures.lead_cue: Side, cross behind on the ball of the foot, replace; then to the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Side, cross behind, replace, the mirror of him.
figures.mistake: Putting the heel down on the cross; stay on the ball.

figures.name: Whisks into Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Two whisks, opening her into promenade on the second one.
figures.follow_cue: Two whisks, turning to promenade on the second one.
figures.mistake: Not opening the hold; turn your body to make room for promenade.

figures.name: Samba Walks in Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Forward, a small part-weight step back, then slip the front foot back a little toward it. Travel side by side.
figures.follow_cue: The same walks as him on the other foot, side by side: forward, small part-weight step back, slip back.
figures.mistake: Taking big strides; samba walks are compact with a pelvic tilt.

figures.name: Side Samba Walk
figures.lead_cue: Like a samba walk, but the part-weight step on 'a' goes to the side; then slip the front foot back a little.
figures.follow_cue: The same walk as him on the other foot in promenade: forward, side on 'a', slip back.
figures.mistake: Losing the 1-a-2 rhythm; the 'a' is very short.

figures.name: Botafogos to Closed
figures.lead_cue: Cross forward, side on the ball, replace; again on the other foot as you bring her back to closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Cross forward, side, replace, ending facing him.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to rotate the body to the side on each cross.

figures.name: Sur Place
figures.lead_cue: March in place on the balls of the feet, proud chest and lifted posture.
figures.follow_cue: March in place with him.
figures.mistake: Letting the posture sag; Paso is upright and proud.

figures.name: Basic Movement
figures.lead_cue: March forward, heel leads, one step per beat.
figures.follow_cue: March back, toe leads.
figures.mistake: Bouncing; Paso marches stay level.

figures.name: Appel and Forward
figures.lead_cue: Stamp in place on the right (the appel), then march forward and close.
figures.follow_cue: Stamp on the left, march back, close.
figures.mistake: Slamming the floor or stamping on the ball; the appel is a short, controlled flat-foot press with the knee softened.

figures.name: Chasses to Left
figures.lead_cue: Appel, then side-close-side along the floor.
figures.follow_cue: Appel on the left, then side-close-side to your right, travelling with him.
figures.mistake: Dropping the heels on the chasse; stay on the balls.

figures.name: Separation
figures.lead_cue: Appel, forward, close, then mark time while she walks away and comes back to you.
figures.follow_cue: Appel, then three steps back away from him, close, and two steps forward back into hold, closing on 8.
figures.mistake: Letting go of the hand; keep the connection as she separates.

figures.name: Promenade Link
figures.lead_cue: Appel, then side and close as you open her into promenade.
figures.follow_cue: Appel, side, close, turning to promenade.
figures.mistake: Staying closed; open her with your body turn.

figures.name: Promenade
figures.lead_cue: Appel, side in promenade, cross through, then side as you bring her back to face you.
figures.follow_cue: Appel, side, through, turn to face him.
figures.mistake: Forgetting the strong shape; stay tall and proud in promenade.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Team video: 'Paso doble promenade into Spanish line' (the Spanish line is a Silver add-on).

figures.name: Basic
figures.lead_cue: Forward break on 2, replace, chasse left; back break, replace, chasse right.
figures.follow_cue: Back break, replace, chasse right; forward break, replace, chasse left.
figures.mistake: Breaking on 1; the break step is on 2.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Basic, raising your left hand on the second half so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Back break, replace, chasse; then step forward on your left and turn right under his arm on 2-3, chasse to face him.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn on the forward half; it happens on the back half.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Turn a quarter and cross the left foot through, replace, chasse back to face; then the other way.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him, crossing the right foot first.
figures.mistake: Bending the supporting knee on the cross; keep the legs straight.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Rock back to open out to arm's length, replace, chasse; repeat the break.
figures.follow_cue: Rock back away from him, replace, chasse; then break back again on the other foot.
figures.mistake: Letting the arms go slack; keep tone so you can lead the next figure.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Break forward, then turn a quarter left out of her way so she walks across in front of you; take her back into hold.
figures.follow_cue: Back break, replace, chasse; then walk forward across his path, turning left to face him on the chasse.
figures.mistake: Standing in her way; step to the side to open the path.

figures.name: Spot Turn
figures.lead_cue: Cross through and turn a full turn to the right on the spot, chasse; then turn back to the left.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him, turning left first.
figures.mistake: Travelling while turning; keep the turn on the spot.

figures.name: Box Step
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, quick side, quick close; slow back, quick side, quick close.
figures.follow_cue: Slow back, side, close; slow forward, side, close.
figures.mistake: Stepping with straight legs at the wrong time; bend the moving knee and straighten as weight arrives (Cuban motion).

figures.name: Progressive Walks
figures.lead_cue: Walk forward slow, quick, quick, with hip action on each step.
figures.follow_cue: Walk back slow, quick, quick, toe first.
figures.mistake: Walking on the heels; Rumba walks go ball-flat.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Box step; raise your left hand on the back half so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Back half, then turn right under his arm and close.
figures.mistake: Pulling her around; just raise the hand and give her room.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Side, then turn and cross through on the right, replace; side, cross through on the left, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him, crossing with the left first.
figures.mistake: Forgetting to come back to face on the side step.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Side, rock back away from her to open out, replace; side, rock back, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Side, rock back away from him, replace.
figures.mistake: Letting go; keep one hand connected with some tone.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, then turn a quarter left out of her path and lead her across; finish in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Back, side, close; then walk forward across his path, turning left on the next quick to face him, and close.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path; step aside before she crosses.

figures.name: Single-Rhythm Basic
figures.lead_cue: Side left, side right, rock back, replace. Six counts.
figures.follow_cue: Side right, side left, rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Rocking forward; the rock step goes back.

figures.name: Triple-Rhythm Basic
figures.lead_cue: Triple step left (1-and-2), triple step right (3-and-4), rock back, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Triple right, triple left, rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Taking big triple steps; keep them small and bouncy.

figures.name: Throwout
figures.lead_cue: Turn a little left on the first triple to send her out to open position.
figures.follow_cue: Triple to your right as he turns, then triple back away from him; rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Throwing with the arm; turn the body to lead it.

figures.name: Lady's Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Raise your left hand on the first triple so she turns right under it; you change places.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right under his arm on the first triple and face him.
figures.mistake: Raising the arm too late; lift it on count 1.

figures.name: Tuck Turn
figures.lead_cue: Draw her in on the first triple, then push gently so she spins right under your arm.
figures.follow_cue: Come in on the first triple, then spin right on the second.
figures.mistake: Spinning her before the tuck; the compression comes first.

figures.name: Return to Closed
figures.lead_cue: From open, draw her in on the triples and take closed hold before the rock.
figures.follow_cue: Triple forward into his arms, triple to your left in closed hold, then rock back, replace.
figures.mistake: Skipping it and doing closed figures from open position.

figures.name: Basic
figures.lead_cue: Slow side with a rise, then quick back break and replace; slow side, quick forward break and replace.
figures.follow_cue: Slow side with a rise, quick forward break and replace; slow side, quick back break and replace.
figures.mistake: Rushing the slow; it is a long, rising side step with body sway.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Bronze Bolero notes.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Slow side, turn and cross through on the right, replace; slow side, cross through on the left, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: slow side, cross through on the left first.
figures.mistake: Not rising on the slow side step.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Bronze Bolero notes.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Basic, raising your left hand on the first quick-quick (your back break) so she turns right under it.
figures.follow_cue: Slow side, then turn right under his arm on your forward quick-quick; slow side, back break, replace.
figures.mistake: Leading it on the second half; she turns on her forward break, which is your back break.
figures.notes_for_beginners: Taught in the team's Bronze Bolero notes.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Slow side, rock back to open out, replace; slow side, rock back again, replace.
figures.follow_cue: Slow side, rock back away from him, replace.
figures.mistake: Going floppy in the arms; keep tone so you can lead the next figure.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Slow forward, turn left out of her way while she crosses, finish in closed hold.
figures.follow_cue: Slow back, side, close; then a slow walk forward across his path, turning left on the next quick to face him, and close.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path.

figures.name: Basic
figures.lead_cue: Break forward on 2, replace on 3, close on 4 and hold 1; then back break.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on 2, replace, close, hold; then forward.
figures.mistake: Stepping on 1; mambo breaks on 2 and holds the 1.

figures.name: Side Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Break to the side on 2, replace, close; then the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him: break to your right first.
figures.mistake: Letting the hips stop; keep the Cuban motion.

figures.name: Crossover Breaks
figures.lead_cue: Turn and cross the left through, replace, close back to face; then the other side.
figures.follow_cue: Mirror him, crossing with the right first.
figures.mistake: Taking a big step; the cross is short and sharp.

figures.name: Underarm Turn
figures.lead_cue: Basic, raising your left hand on the back half so she turns right.
figures.follow_cue: Turn right under his arm on 2-3, close on 4.
figures.mistake: Leading the turn on 1.

figures.name: Open Break
figures.lead_cue: Break back away from her on 2, replace, close; repeat.
figures.follow_cue: Break back away from him, replace, close.
figures.mistake: Losing the hand connection.

figures.name: Cross Body Lead
figures.lead_cue: Break forward, then turn left out of her way as she crosses; close up in hold.
figures.follow_cue: Break back on the first 2-3-4; on the second 2-3-4 walk forward across his path and turn left to face him.
figures.mistake: Blocking her path.
